description: This file contains debug function declarations related to nl80211 wireless interface information structures and is intended for debugging purposes within a wireless driver or management component. It declares functions to dump various nl80211 info structures into variant maps for logging or debugging.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_dumpIfaceInfo
methods.description: Dumps wiphy interface info into a variant map for debugging.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_dumpWiphyInfo
methods.description: Dumps wiphy info into a variant map for debugging.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_dumpStationInfo
methods.description: Dumps station info into a variant map for debugging.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_dumpAllStationInfo
methods.description: Dumps all station info into a map tree for debugging.
